eligibility.rule: At least 200 frozen eligible throws and ten eligible games in each season independently; team changes pool by raw GSIS ID.
eligibility.population: Recorded passers, not position-certified; frozen 560 actor-seasons; no adjacent-season requirement.
eligibility.model_limit: Generating CP/EP model and training vintage unknown; observed seasonal values are not era-neutral skill or forecasts.
eligibility.missing_player_season: No eligible record; do not substitute another year/player or a zero.

denominators.cpoe_pp: Mean supplied CPOE over all frozen E throws; percentage points.
denominators.completion_pct: 100 times completions divided by the same E throws; matched-row diagnostic.
denominators.epa_per_dropback: Sum supplied raw EPA on all frozen actor D divided by D, including sacks and scramble-runs; shared play value.
denominators.sack_avoidance_pct: 100*(D minus recorded sacks)/D; recorded outcome proxy, not pocket presence.

uncertainty.epa: Approximate marginal 95% conditional complete D-game deletion sensitivity: theta +/-1.96*sqrt((G-1)/G*sum((deletion-mean(deletion))^2)). All actor D games; frozen qualification; no replicate drops.
uncertainty.collapsed: No observed deletion variation, not certainty.
uncertainty.limitations: Approximately independent game shocks conditional on fixed opportunities/player-season/support/model and selection; excludes serial dependence, source/model error and support uncertainty. Marginal bars do not test player/year differences.
uncertainty.interpretation: EPA is shared with receivers/protection/scheme/opposition; CPOE is model-dependent; overlapping outcomes are not independent traits.

player_names.use: Display names only, exact raw GSIS ID match.
